verdict.rationale: Sunbiz lets a filer download a free image of each processed annual report and order certified copies. It also documents a filing to dissolve or withdraw an entity, which is the closest analogue to 'leaving.' These are per-document image downloads, not a bulk export of all entity data in open, machine-readable formats. Missing for 10: bulk/full-account data export, open or structured formats (e.g. CSV/JSON) rather than document images, and independent corroboration of the export path.
